long_biography.plain_text:
Keeping BISSELL independent as a family manufacturer became the defining governance challenge of Mark Bissell's leadership. He led a recapitalisation that concentrated ownership among active family members and restricted third-party share transfers. The new structure aligned control with the relatives directly involved in running the company.

Bissell paired that long-term ownership model with a practical management rhythm. Functional leaders met regularly to address immediate opportunities and threats, while product teams used consumer feedback and international market knowledge to guide development. Pet owners' frustrations prompted a tangle-free brush roll, and wet-floor cleaning habits in China informed an all-in-one cleaner.
